title: 학교, 식당, 접시: ㄱ·ㄷ·ㅂ 받침 뒤 된소리
objective: By the end, you can read words like 학교, 식당, and 접시 aloud with the correct tense sound. You can also tell when this change happens and when it does not.
summary: This worksheet shows how ㄱ, ㄷ, ㅂ, ㅅ, ㅈ become tense sounds after the final consonants ㄱ, ㄷ, and ㅂ, as in 학교 [학꾜].

task.title: Read and say it right
task.line: Look at each final consonant, decide if the next sound gets tense, and write or choose the real sound.

words.exampleMeaning: I eat lunch at a restaurant.
Can I have a spoon, please?
There's a bag on the desk.

letters.as: The next sound becomes tense, like 'k' in 'sky' and 't' in 'stop': tight, with no puff of air.
The next sound becomes tense, like 'k' in 'sky' and 't' in 'stop': tight, with no puff of air.
It also happens before particles. ㅆ is a strong 's', like 'ss' in 'hiss'.
Write and romanize the plain letter. Only the sound changes.

exercises: Write the real sound in [ ]: ① 국밥 ② 입구 ③ 듣기
Write the tense consonant you hear in the second syllable: ① 학생 ② 맥주 ③ 받다
Does the second syllable get a tense sound? Write Yes or No: ① 한국 ② 약국 ③ 사진
Choose the correct sound: ① 국수: [국수] / [국쑤] ② 식사: [식싸] / [식사] ③ 책가방: [책가방] / [책까방]
Write the sound of the word in 「 」 in [ ]: ① 주말에 「축구」를 해요. ② 「밥도」 먹어요. ③ 공원에서 「걷고」 싶어요.
answers: ① ㅆ [학쌩] ② ㅉ [맥쭈] ③ ㄸ [받따]
① No (ㄴ is not ㄱ·ㄷ·ㅂ) ② Yes [약꾹] ③ No (사 has no final consonant)
